tweets.text:
The American Warrior is Back 👊🏼🇺🇸

I have never seen God protect any man like Pete Hegseth. From bullets on the battlefield, to political hit jobs in the Senate, to dirty kill shots from inside the deep state: our Secretary of Defense has been under attack — because he is a massive threat to evil.

Speak to any military man or woman and they’ll tell you: The Pentagon became unrecognizably woke over the past decade - demoralizing the troops and culminating in the humiliating surrender in Afghanistan. The worst part about this is it was all by design. Pagan globalist elites want a weak, castrated America - the best way to accomplish this by destroying our great warriors. 

This is why Pete Hegseth is such a threat. SecDef has TURNED the TIDE against the enemy. Restoring honor to the American fighting man and ruthlessly eradicating toxic, radical poisons injected into our military by our enemies. The effect is skyrocketing military recruitment and global respect once again for our nation.

Secretary Hegseth continues to take bullets for this country, the least we can do is support him with everything we got. I stand with @PeteHegseth and am excited to work with him in the future to Make The American Military Great Again. Support @SecDef
